name: navigated_flowline_properties
description: navigated_flowline_properties schema from CIP-service Indexing API

uphydroseq.description: NHDPlus int64 upstream flowline hydro sequence identifier.

dnhydroseq.description: NHDPlus int64 downstream flowline hydro sequence identifier.

lengthkm.description: length of the navigated flowline in kilometers.

flowtimeday.description: flow time in days of the navigated flowline.

network_distancekm.description: total length from start to the navigated flowline in kilometers.

network_flowtimeday.description: total flow time in days from start to the navigated flowline.

permanent_identifier.description: NHD permanent identifier of the navigated flowline.

reachcode.description: NHD reach code of the navigated flowline

fcode.description: NHD feature type code of the navigated flowline.

gnis_id.description: NHD GNIS identifier of the navigated flowline.

gnis_name.description: NHD GNIS name of the navigated flowline.

wbarea_permanent_identifier.description: NHD permanent identifier of the NHD waterbody feature associated with a flowline artificial path.

navtermination_flag.description: Integer code providing information about the navigated flowline within the context of the navigation. Valid codes are: 0. no termination 1. full termination 2. partial termination 3. coastal termination 4. headwater termination 5. network end termination (non-coastal)

nav_order.description: rough ordering key placing flowlines in navigated order
